name: Oil Paint
desc: Repaints the live canvas as an oil painting — hundreds of rotated brush dabs following a flow field, colors sampled from the scene, impasto highlight ridges on each stroke, canvas weave texture, and a warm gallery light slowly sweeping the picture. Styles: impressionist dabs, swirling van Gogh strokes, round pointillist dots, broad palette-knife smears, wet-blended.
